text:
Our Favorite Faux Brick Design Ideas

Faux brick is a great way to add layers of character and depth to your home’s design, whether it’s inside or outside the house.

With a fantastic variety of styles, ranging from classic red brick to deep, stone-colored veneers, there’s so much opportunity to be creative when it comes to installing faux brick panels.

Give your kitchen or bedroom a quick makeover, or create a rustic fireplace in the living room. To inspire your next DIY project , here are our favorite faux brick design ideas that you can put into action today.

Give Your Living Room a Faux Brick Makeover

It’s a simple design idea, but it’s the simplicity of adding a faux brick wall to your living room that makes it such a popular interior makeover move.

If you’re looking to add a unique touch to your living space or to breathe a breath of fresh air into your home, then you can have a faux brick wall up in as little as a few hours.

You can cover all your existing living room walls in faux brick, for uniformity, or you can create a much more interesting style of your own by only paneling one wall, and leaving the others as they are.

Faux Stone Brick Accent Wall in a Bed & Breakfast Waiting Room

Create a Focal Point in the Room

If you’re not ready to faux brick an entire wall, then why not take a minimalist approach and use faux brick to create a focal point in the room?

Faux brick, especially in deep shades of red, can create a vivid point of focus in a living area, or even in the bedroom. Just add faux brick to a small area of the wall, and it immediately draws the attention of anyone entering the room.

You can use the focal point just to stand out, or you can use it as a space to hang a television or a work of art; it’s totally up to you.

Faux Brick Fireplaces

If it’s a faux brick focal point you’re looking to craft, then look no further than building a faux brick fireplace.

If you already have a fireplace built into the wall, you can simply add faux brick panels in a style of your choice around the existing structure. It’s a quick and easy job that instantly changes the character of the room.

If you are looking to build a new fireplace, then you can incorporate faux brick into the overall design.

Faux Brick Pillars

Faux brick pillars and columns can be a fantastic way to add character to the corners of your room or to hide structural supports inside the house. They look great, and they provide a cover for an otherwise bland part of the home.

You can also incorporate faux brick pillars and columns outside the house, too. They can add a new dimension to a doorway, or you can even use them at the entrance to the property. Pillars and columns are also perfect for designing new, faux brick mailboxes.

Hidden Doors

A classic use for faux brick panels is to craft a concealed or hidden doorway inside or outside of the home.

If you need a secure area or just want to hide away every now and then, then concealed entrances can be covered up using faux brick walls.

Faux Brick Wall Art

When it comes to faux brick design ideas, you’re only really limited by your imagination. There are countless projects you can work on, and you can even get creative and artsy.

Faux brick can be used to work unique art designs into the walls themselves. You can merge different styles of brick, or work with multiple materials to create different designs. You can create lettering or even entire scenes using a combination of plain walls and faux brick.

There are so many great options, and that’s why faux brick is one of our favorite materials to work with when it comes to design work!
